extraction.notes: Company reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. ffo_total and core_total are the non-diluted "applicable to common shares and Units" subtotals (23,549 and 24,980); the diluted figures (23,607 and 25,038, adding back Series D preferred distributions of 58) are not used as totals. Per-share check: 23,607 / 19,699 = $1.20 and 25,038 / 19,699 = $1.27, matching reported. Zero-valued (printed "—") lines are included in printed order. Mapping judgment: "Legal and other costs related to strategic review" (127) placed in 'legal'; could arguably be transaction_costs. Recurring capex: the only disclosure is Same-Store Total Recurring Capital Expenditures of $303 per apartment home for the quarter (page seq 23, printed S-15). It is a per-unit figure, not a total in thousands, so it is not recorded as an amount; left null. Starting line and all reconciliation lines are on page seq 16 (printed S-8); the diluted share count is from the same page.
